scenario: Big Board readiness summaries and readable status counts
replay_steps: Start Big Board with the fictional Academy department and seeded roster/units.
Use Add to choose each of the three readiness summary widgets; scroll to the actual panels.
Use Settings, Personnel Status Widget; set Show Colors off, leave font14pt, choose4x4 grid dimensions, then Save.
Inspect neutral status numbers and separate staffing/unit counts.
Scroll to the Units table and compare individual states and Updated ages.
Reload, inspect the returned summaries, reopen Personnel Status Widget and read back saved settings.
limits: This records a long scrollable board, not a finished wall-display arrangement.
Raw font16 attempts did not persist; do not replay or teach them as a working change.
Relative ages depend on the recording date and should not be reproduced by silently altering records.
Unit Available counts use grouped underlying categories, not literal state-label matching.
